title: Unit – 1 : Session – 6 | Our Program — Harmony at All Levels
sections: Q1. Method to fulfil the basic aspirations: (1) UNDERSTAND the harmony at all four levels of being — (a) harmony in the SELF (right understanding & right feeling), (b) harmony in the FAMILY (feelings of trust, respect... leading to mutual fulfilment), (c) harmony in SOCIETY (fearlessness/trust as the foundation, leading to a universal human order), (d) harmony with NATURE/EXISTENCE (mutual enrichment, co-existence). (2) LIVE in that harmony — express it in behaviour with humans and work with nature. Understanding + living, together, fulfil the aspiration of continuous happiness and prosperity.

Q2. 'Our Program' is two-fold: (A) UNDERSTANDING THE HARMONY — through self-exploration, verifying proposals on one's own right; (B) LIVING IN HARMONY — with human beings (behaviour) and the rest of nature (work). PROCESS of checking proposals: every proposal is examined in self-exploration — Is it naturally acceptable to me? Is it experientially verifiable in my living? Does it lead to harmony at all levels? If yes, accept and live it; if not, keep exploring. Nothing is accepted on the basis of scripture, authority, or majority opinion alone.

Q3. Apparent conflict between levels arises from partial (fragmented) solutions — e.g., individual comfort bought by exploiting society or nature, which eventually rebounds on the individual. A program for continuity of happiness must therefore be HOLISTIC: harmony at each level must be sought IN RELATION to the other levels, not against them. Working at the INDIVIDUAL level is the foundation: a person with right understanding naturally behaves with trust and respect in the family, participates justly in society, and uses nature with restraint — so harmony in the Self radiates outward to all other levels.
